newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's crown prince in Israel on peace mission.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's crown prince in Israel on peace mission.

text.p: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan arrived on a lightning visit to Jerusalem on Wednesday hoping to ease Israeli-Palestinian tensions heightened by a bloody suicide attack.

Witnesses said the crown prince arrived by helicopter. He and Jordan's Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali were due to hold talks with Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu and convene a news conference around 1130 GMT.
